create_wrapper_dataset: create a BaseWrapperDataset that wraps an existing FairseqDataset and delegates all operations to it
collate_samples: collate a list of samples using the wrapped dataset's collater or default_collate as fallback
batch_by_size: batch dataset indices by size using max_tokens and max_sentences constraints via the wrapped dataset
filter_indices_by_size: filter dataset indices by size constraints using the wrapped dataset's filter_indices_by_size method
prefetch_dataset: prefetch specific indices from the wrapped dataset for improved data loading performance
